title: A 2-step Framework for Automated Literary Translation Evaluation: Its Promises and Pitfalls

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing scores assigned by an LLM-as-a-judge to human-generated versus LLM-generated literary translations, revealing a systematic tendency for the LLM to overestimate and favor LLM-generated texts over superior human translations.

Evaluating the LLM judge's capability to recognize and appropriately score culturally specific linguistic features (specifically, the complex social hierarchy embedded in Korean honorifics), comparing the model's accuracy and score distribution against human expert agreement.
